name: Takahashi Moriyama
source:
Takahashi Moriyama, the stoic history professor, is a man of few words. He loves to travel and loses himself in his studies. Young, dashing, and tall, many women are deeply captivated by him. But his cold eyes and serious nature can leave anyone frozen in fear. Misunderstood, it is hard for Takahashi to converse with others, and he dislikes talking about his past. 

[From Kickstarter]
